source.summary: GitHub Actions ‘Embedder footprint’ runs for PR #353 (branch fix/318-extern-names at head 0dd39b5425c11aafdfdb5ac28d0b87087e15ca4b — the #318 change (split extern-name encodings (name prefix 0x02: implements / version-suffix / external-id) decode, and extern names are validated against the package-name grammar) merged with current main d5af7b8e004daff28d1735657155d3df5802d8a3 (PRs #348, #351 and #350), with no merge conflicts; ubuntu-24.04, Rust 1.96.0): workflow_dispatch runs 45591081391, 45591092701 and 45591107329 against the branch and pull-request run 45591075501, which built the same tree, produced byte-identical sizes for every gated series
source.derivation: Re-baseline for PR #353 (#318, split extern-name encodings decode and extern names are validated against the package-name grammar). The branch merged current main (merge commit 0dd39b5, main at d5af7b8e004daff28d1735657155d3df5802d8a3 — PR #348 (#342, canonical lift/lower transfers resource handles across component call boundaries), PR #351 (#331, trap invalid variant discriminants with the canonical message) and PR #350 (#330, core-to-component char conversions trap with the canonical ‘invalid `char` bit pattern’ message) on top of the main at 90f1437b1445b8523daa2f78eecb366de415ed11 the branch was based on); the merge was conflict-free, and its CI run on the merged tree tripped the gate on the twelve series of the three configurations that link telomere-component. Attribution was isolated by measuring current main alone three times (workflow_dispatch runs 45591120085, 45591130821 and 45591141591 on main at d5af7b8e004daff28d1735657155d3df5802d8a3; all three runs pass the gate against main’s checked-in baseline). Against the checked-in baseline, the main control is byte-identical on 29 of the 32 gated series; on the three release stripped file series of component, wasi and wasi-threads it measures −32 B below that baseline, the branch-tree snapshot staleness recorded for PRs #348 and #350 (the gate passes shrinkage, so the staleness was inert). This PR’s own delta against the main control is confined to the same 12 series: in release, stripped file +17,960 B (component), +17,976 B (wasi) and +17,976 B (wasi-threads) and stripped .text +16,416 B in each; in release-size, stripped file +10,328 B / +10,328 B / +10,296 B and stripped .text +9,056 B / +9,056 B / +9,040 B. Every other configuration is byte-identical to main in both profiles. All twelve series exceed the checked-in baseline, so those twelve are re-baselined to the branch measurements. Run-to-run spread was 0 B for every gated series across the four branch samples and across the three main samples. Against the original #164 baseline, the largest cumulative growth is now the release component stripped file series at +11.02% (2,433,656 B to 2,701,856 B), up from +10.29%; the release core-nosimd stripped file series is unchanged at +9.83% (1,275,448 B to 1,400,840 B). The core-aot configuration, added by PR #267 after the #164 baseline, is not part of the cumulative comparison.
